findings.summary: INSERT OR REPLACE can overwrite an immutable TaskSpec revision when SQLite recursive_triggers is disabled by default.
findings.evidence: Reviewer reproduced replacement of an existing (task_id, revision) in an in-memory TaskRepository; existing independent coverage rejected only explicit UPDATE and DELETE.

findings.summary: The v1 to v2 migration copies invalidated_revisions before the decision-kind trigger exists.
findings.evidence: Reviewer migrated a v1 row whose invalidation authority was same-Task scope_approved; migration reached user_version=2 and foreign_key_check returned no violations.

candidate_observation.attribution: Root graphify query after review dispatch

required_followup: Add independent regressions, correct both findings, freeze a new candidate, and perform delta review.
